meta.subtitle: My Dad Is in Business · Interactive learning preview

dialogue: 大文
张莉，照片里面的人是谁？
Zhang Li, who are the people in the photo?
zhāng lì, zhào piàn lǐ miàn de rén shì shéi?

data:image/webp;base64,
张莉
左边是我外公，他以前是医生，右边是我外婆。
On the left is my maternal grandfather. He used to be a doctor. On the right is my maternal grandmother.
zuǒ biān shì wǒ wài gōng, tā yǐ qián shì yī shēng, yòu biān shì wǒ wài pó.

data:image/webp;base64,
大文
你爸爸妈妈做什么工作？
What work do your parents do?
nǐ bà ba mā ma zuò shén me gōng zuò?

data:image/webp;base64,
张莉
我爸爸做生意，我妈妈帮他。你爸爸妈妈呢？
My dad does business, and my mom helps him. What about your parents?
wǒ bà ba zuò shēng yì, wǒ mā ma bāng tā. nǐ bà ba mā ma ne?

data:image/webp;base64,
大文
我爸爸在电脑公司上班，我妈妈在银行工作。
My dad works at a computer company, and my mom works at a bank.
wǒ bà ba zài diàn nǎo gōng sī shàng bān, wǒ mā ma zài yín háng gōng zuò.

data:image/webp;base64,
大文
你以后想做什么？
What do you want to do in the future?
nǐ yǐ hòu xiǎng zuò shén me?

data:image/webp;base64,
张莉
我以后想跟爸爸一样。
I want to be like my dad in the future.
wǒ yǐ hòu xiǎng gēn bà ba yí yàng.

reading.title: Reading Comprehension · 阅读理解
reading.instruction: Read Ms. Wang’s story and answer the questions.
passage: 我爸爸以前在电脑公司上班，我妈妈以前在银行工作。
wǒ bà ba yǐ qián zài diàn nǎo gōng sī shàng bān, wǒ mā ma yǐ qián zài yín háng gōng zuò.
My father used to work at a computer company, and my mother used to work at a bank.
他们常常不在家。
tā men cháng cháng bú zài jiā.
They were often away from home.
我爷爷以前是医生，我奶奶以前在中文学校工作。
wǒ yé ye yǐ qián shì yī shēng, wǒ nǎi nai yǐ qián zài zhōng wén xué xiào gōng zuò.
My paternal grandfather used to be a doctor, and my paternal grandmother used to work at a Chinese school.
那时候我十岁。
nà shí hou wǒ shí suì.
At that time, I was ten years old.
我最喜欢跟奶奶一起看书。
wǒ zuì xǐ huan gēn nǎi nai yì qǐ kàn shū.
I liked reading books with Grandma the most.
奶奶常常问我以后想做什么？
nǎi nai cháng cháng wèn wǒ yǐ hòu xiǎng zuò shén me?
Grandma often asked me what I wanted to do when I grew up.
我以后想跟她一样。
wǒ yǐ hòu xiǎng gēn tā yí yàng.
I want to be like her in the future.
